test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence.

__Play cards__ is not allowed here
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"play"** means to engage in an activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose. (खेलना)

 
 
• **Example: **Children love to **play** in the park.
 
 
 
• **"Playing cards" **refers to the activity of using a set of cards for games, gambling, or magic tricks. (ताश खेलना)
 
 
• **Example:** **Playing cards **is a common pastime during family gatherings.
 
 

Hence, the phrase** 'Playing cards'** correctly substitutes the underlined segment in the sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Playing card **(ताश का पत्ता): Refers to a single card from a deck used for playing games.

 
 
• **Example:** He picked a playing card from the deck.
 
 
 
• **Play card **(ताश खेलना): Incorrect form for the context of the sentence.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: Play card is not allowed here.
 
 
 
• **Played cards** (ताश खेली): Refers to the past action of playing cards.
 
 
• **Example:** They played cards all night.
 
 

46:T64f,
The correct answer is **Option 1)**<
